snippet.title: Hmmsim Metro - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591420/Hmmsim_Metro/

Line 1, the most complicated subway in Seoul, is now coming in PC version. You can feel high immersion with the graphics that realize the actual Seoul scenery, the train driving sound, and the realistic train driving system. Experience the operation of the Seoul subway!

Music by Hyejun-Kim
